subject: Post-call: Deployment mode & isolation follow-up (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Mehta <samir.mehta@finpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: Deployment mode & isolation (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Hi Samir — great speaking earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment.

Summary from our call:
- FinPay is evaluating deployment modes for your customer-facing transaction enrichment service (low-latency inference for fraud signals).
- Primary concerns: noisy-neighbor interference on shared pools, p99 latency SLOs under peak, and isolation/compliance for financial data.
- Traffic profile you mentioned: ~1200 concurrent sessions at peak, avg request size ~350 tokens, bursts up to ~1800 RPS for short windows.

How Redwood maps to those needs (high level):
- Hosted API: fastest to get started, multi-tenant with caching and workload isolation primitives; good for early testing but not SLA-backed isolation.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools with tenant isolation boundaries, predictable throughput, configurable SLOs and can guarantee reduced noisy-neighbor risk.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): for strict compliance/data residency; full network isolation and customer-managed control plane.

Open items / asks from us to size next steps:
1) Can you confirm peak sustained RPS and p99 latency target (example: p99 < 200ms)?
2) Any hard compliance requirements (SOC2 type already flagged, PCI scope, on-prem requirement)?
3) Who should be on the technical deep-dive from FinPay (you mentioned Alex)?

Next suggested steps:
- I’ll share our SLO & isolation brief and a Draft Dedicated Trial plan (attached).
- If agreed, propose a technical deep-dive next week (30–45m) with our infra team to scope the Dedicated pilot.

Attachments: redwood_infra_slos.pdf (SLOs & isolation brief), redwood_dedicated_trial_plan.pdf (high-level pilot plan)

Thanks — looking forward to locking down the pilot scope.
—
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

From: Samir Mehta <samir.mehta@finpay.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Patel <alex.patel@finpay.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Deployment mode & isolation (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Thanks Priyom — helpful recap. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Latency SLO: Our product team wants p50 < 50ms, p95 < 120ms, p99 < 250ms for inference. During heavy traffic we can tolerate p99 spikes for short windows, but regular spikes >400ms are a blocker.
2) Throughput: Peak sustained is closer to 1300 RPS, with 1–2 minute bursts up to ~1800 RPS.
3) Compliance: We’re not doing on-prem today, but need SOC2 evidence and strong audit logs for PCI scoping (we will likely remain in-cloud but need isolation).
4) Technical contacts: Alex (cc'd) will own the infra deep-dive. He can pull in security if needed.

Two questions: can Hosted API be configured with per-tenant isolation buckets and what level of p99 guarantees do you offer on Dedicated? Also can you share what noisy-neighbor mitigation looks like (e.g., dedicated GPUs, scheduling isolation, admission control)?

If Dedicated plan looks reasonable we can run a short pilot — Alex and I are available for a tech deep-dive next Tue/Wed (Jan 20/21) morning PT.

Samir
Director of Product, FinPay
samir.mehta@finpay.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Mehta <samir.mehta@finpay.com>
Cc: Alex Patel <alex.patel@finpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Deployment mode & isolation (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Hi Samir / Alex — great questions. Short answers below, and I’ve pulled in Marissa (solutions) and Vivek (infra) for technical detail during the deep-dive.

1) Hosted API isolation:
- Hosted uses logical tenant isolation with workload-aware scheduling and per-tenant request queues. We have prefix/KV caching and throttles to reduce noisy-neighbor impact, but it is still multi-tenant and not SLA-backed for isolation. Good for PoCs and early-stage traffic.

2) Dedicated guarantees:
- Dedicated capacity provides reserved GPU pools for your account. We offer configurable SLO targets on Dedicated and can set throughput reservations to minimize contention. For your profile (1300–1800 RPS), Dedicated lets us size a reserve to keep p99 within your target under expected bursts.

3) Noisy-neighbor mitigation (how we implement it):
- Physical isolation via reserved instances / tenant affinity to GPU pools.
- Runtime: admission control, shaping, preemptive batching limits, and per-tenant KV cache prioritization.
- Observability: token-level cost/latency breakdowns, and tracing to detect cross-tenant interference.

Attached I included a short SLO & isolation brief and a draft Dedicated trial runbook (plan shows pilot goals, duration, acceptance criteria). Also link to our SLO doc: https://redwood-inference.docs/slo-and-isolation.

Proposed next steps:
- Schedule 45m deep-dive with Alex + our infra engineers (Vivek + Marissa).
- If pilot is greenlit, we spin up a Dedicated trial pool for ~2 weeks with telemetry to validate p99 under your burst profile.

I’ll create a HubSpot opportunity and calendar invite for Jan 20/21 morning PT. Any preference between the two dates?

Priyom

From: Alex Patel <alex.patel@finpay.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Samir Mehta <samir.mehta@finpay.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Deployment mode & isolation (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Thanks — Jan 20 morning PT works for me (we'll aim 9:30am PT). I'm looping in FinPay infra (security) if we need to review logs and compliance during the call.

Quick note on acceptance criteria for the pilot:
- Dedicated pool must keep p99 < 300ms during a 24-hour simulated burst window that includes two 1–2 minute spikes to 1800 RPS.
- Access to audit logs and request tracing for the pilot window.
- Clear rollback and cost-estimate at pilot end.

We'll be looking for a short pricing/commitment window if the pilot validates performance. Please include a one-page summary of pilot costs in the invite.

Alex
Lead Infrastructure Engineer, FinPay
alex.patel@finpay.com
